source.description: Additive, read-only (docs/adr/0025). Where the path came from: `flow` is a process flow consumed from process-path-management. Since stage 3 retired the local declaration it is the only value that occurs; `local` stays in the enum for readers written against stage 1.
source.title: ProcessPathSource

404.description: No ACTIVE process flow and no locally declared path under id (process-path-not-found).

500.description: An unexpected failure (a store or outbox error). Answered as problem+json (internal-error). A 5xx answer is never stored under an Idempotency-Key and rolls back the aggregate change and its outbox rows, so the retry re-executes.
